description: Defines a template class 'region_operator' for boolean operations on regions, including nested classes for region rasterization and span management, used in UI region handling within Android.

classes.name: region_operator
classes.description: Template class for performing boolean operations on regions, with nested classes for rasterization and span management.

classes.name: region_operator::region
classes.description: Represents a region composed of rectangles with positional offsets.

classes.name: region_operator::SpannerBase
classes.description: Base class for managing span boundaries during region operations.

classes.name: region_operator::Spanner
classes.description: Manages spans of regions for boolean operations.

classes.name: region_operator::SpannerInner
classes.description: Handles inner span processing within regions.

methods.name: region_operator
methods.description: Constructor initializing operation mask and span management.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the boolean operation on a rasterizer over the region.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next span or boundary in region processing.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares span boundaries based on current inside/outside state.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if region processing is complete.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances to the next span within a region.
